literal: Occurred affliction having removed, not occurring beforehand protecting, those of such nature having cherished, one should take.
translation: Cherish and secure the companionship of those who have the ability to remove present afflictions and guard against future ones.
modern: வந்த துன்பத்தை நீக்கி, இனிமேல் துன்பம் வராதபடி முன்னதாகவே காக்கும் தன்மையுடைய பெரியோர்களை விரும்பித் துணையாகக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the value of associating with capable and wise individuals. The word 'நோய்' (nōy) here means any affliction or trouble, not just physical disease. The phrase 'உற்ற நோய் நீக்கி' refers to their ability to solve current problems, while 'உறாஅமை முற்காக்கும்' highlights their foresight in preventing future troubles. By using 'பேணிக் கொளல்', the poet advises the leader to actively cherish and secure such people as their companions.
